editorial.meta_description: The IREM Certified Property Manager exam evaluates professional expertise in maintenance, human resources, marketing, financial operations, asset management.
editorial.overview: The Certified Property Manager (CPM) designation is offered by the Institute of Real Estate Management (IREM). This professional certification validates expertise in managing property and maximizing value across diverse asset classes. The assessment process includes a 150-question exam that evaluates core competencies in maintenance, human resources, marketing, financial operations, asset management, and legal risk management to ensure high standards of practice.
editorial.who_should_take: This certification is intended for property and asset managers who have successfully accumulated the required real estate management experience. Candidates must also maintain active IREM candidacy before they are eligible for graduation.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Candidates should complete the required IREM certification courses before attempting the Capstone. Utilize the IREM Financial Analysis Spreadsheet and review the CPM Exam Prep Tutorial to practice core concepts. The exam is open-book, so organize your course materials and PDF resources for quick reference. Ensure you have a financial calculator for complex loan and valuation calculations during the test.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers the creation of proactive maintenance programs and long-term capital improvement plans. Candidates learn to manage property inspections and coordinate contractor RFP management processes to maintain high asset standards for various types of properties.

This domain focuses on effective team leadership, recruitment strategies, and staff management within property operations. It emphasizes defining roles, managing hiring and termination processes, and staying updated on current staff training trends to improve overall team performance.

This domain addresses marketing and leasing strategies designed to optimize tenant mix and rentable space. Candidates study market and competitive analysis, lease negotiation techniques, and methods for setting competitive rental rates to ensure high occupancy levels.

This domain covers accounting approaches, financial reporting, and budget forecasting for investment real estate. It includes detailed study of cash and accrual accounting, budget variance analysis, and managing operating expense pass-throughs for properties to ensure financial stability.

This domain focuses on property valuation, cash flow projections, and investment analysis. Candidates learn to perform discounted cash flow analysis, derive capitalization rates, and evaluate various loan packages to support informed investment decisions regarding their managed assets.

This domain covers risk management, insurance coverage, and ethical decision-making frameworks. It focuses on emergency and disaster planning, understanding insurance requirements, and applying the Five Question Method for resolving complex ethical dilemmas in the workplace.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: The exam is an open-book, 150-question multiple-choice assessment. You have 240 minutes to complete the test in an online proctored environment. Ensure your testing space is quiet and your technology meets the required specifications before starting the exam.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The CPM Certification Exam consists of 150 multiple-choice questions. These questions are designed to cover the core domains of marketing, leasing, maintenance, operations, legal, risk management, finance, and asset management to ensure an evaluation of your professional property management skills.

The passing score for the CPM Certification Exam is 70%. Candidates must achieve this minimum percentage to successfully demonstrate their competency across all required domains and earn the professional designation from the Institute of Real Estate Management.

The exam duration is 240 minutes. It is administered in an online proctored setting, providing candidates with time to reference their materials and complete the required multiple-choice questions to demonstrate their professional knowledge.

faq.question_title: What is the current certification path?
faq.answer_text: Check with IREM (Institute of Real Estate Management) for the current certification path. The program requires completing all certification courses, passing the CPM Capstone, and meeting specific experience requirements to qualify for the final designation and professional certification.

methodology.summary: This page was built by synthesizing the official IREM CPM Handbook and verified exam facts to provide a structured, accurate overview of the certification requirements, exam logistics, and domain coverage for prospective candidates.
